description: Compute a line-by-line diff between two texts. Operations: "compare" — Diff two texts and return the lines plus statistics.; "unified" — Produce a unified-diff text between two inputs.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: compare: The original text. unified: The original text.

operation.description: compare — Diff two texts and return the lines plus statistics. unified — Produce a unified-diff text between two inputs.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

ignoreBlankLines.description: Ignore blank lines. Used by: compare.

ignoreTrailingWhitespace.description: Ignore whitespace at line ends. Used by: compare.

ignoreWhitespace.description: Ignore all whitespace. Used by: compare.

modified.description: The modified text. Used by: compare, unified. Required by: compare, unified.

name: diff
title: Diff Checker
